creators.name: Holtdirk, Tobias
creators.affiliation: LMU Munich, SODA Lab (Social Data Science and AI Lab)

abstract: Direct forecast of the megastudy's 16 x 13 treatment-effect table by a single stateless LLM completion (claude-opus-5, 3 draws, cell-wise median) given the verbatim intervention texts, item wordings and sample description; control levels and subgroup offsets anchored on public surveys; Tier-1 rows synthesised backwards from the predicted table. Calibration multiplier fitted on 13 held-out published experiments but deliberately not applied (policy 'none'). No human edited any prediction.
approach_family: analysis-first prediction (ATEs, cell means, moderation and distributions predicted directly) with backward synthesis of the Tier-1 rows; no per-respondent generation
note: calibrated prediction of the target megastudy
variant_note: COMBINED candidate card built from 20260815-target-01 under the operator's TASK_20 rulings. Sections 1-3 are IDENTICAL to 20260815-target-01 (Tier 3 and Tier 2 main equal to 1e-9; the condition x moderator interaction contrast equal and exactly 0). Three changes, all in the baseline/offset layer: belief_post control_sd 22.27 -> 26.96; age_band/education/income/race subgroup offsets x 0.50; gender=Other x trust -7.04 -> +14.46 with Male/Female re-centred -0.2123. Pre-registration: runs/_target03/PREREG.md. Renamed from primary to secondary-1 on 2026-08-30 (operator decision after idea_03's sealed internal test); file content unchanged, sha256 9ce16559...
